en.text: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 「你若留意听从耶和华—你 神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。

zhTraditional.text: 「你若留意聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，謹守遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下萬民之上。

en.text: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

zhSimplified.text: 你若听从耶和华—你 神的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上：

zhTraditional.text: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，這以下的福必追隨你，臨到你身上：

en.text: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

zhSimplified.text: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。

zhTraditional.text: 你在城裏必蒙福，在田間也必蒙福。

en.text: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

zhSimplified.text: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必蒙福。

zhTraditional.text: 你身所生的，地所產的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必蒙福。

en.text: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。

zhTraditional.text: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必蒙福。

en.text: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

zhSimplified.text: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。

zhTraditional.text: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。

en.text: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

zhSimplified.text: 「仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败；他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。

zhTraditional.text: 「仇敵起來攻擊你，耶和華必使他們在你面前被你殺敗；他們從一條路來攻擊你，必從七條路逃跑。

en.text: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

zhSimplified.text: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华—你 神也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。

zhTraditional.text: 在你倉房裏，並你手所辦的一切事上，耶和華所命的福必臨到你。耶和華－你上帝也要在所給你的地上賜福與你。

en.text: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 你若谨守耶和华—你 神的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。

zhTraditional.text: 你若謹守耶和華－你上帝的誡命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作為自己的聖民。

en.text: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

zhSimplified.text: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。

zhTraditional.text: 天下萬民見你歸在耶和華的名下，就要懼怕你。

en.text: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

zhSimplified.text: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。

zhTraditional.text: 你在耶和華向你列祖起誓應許賜你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所產的，都綽綽有餘。

en.text: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向他们借贷。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必為你開天上的府庫，按時降雨在你的地上。在你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不致向他們借貸。

en.text: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

zhSimplified.text: 你若听从耶和华—你 神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，谨守遵行，不偏左右，也不随从事奉别神，耶和华就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」 （利26·14—46）

zhTraditional.text: 你若聽從耶和華－你上帝的誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，謹守遵行，不偏左右，也不隨從事奉別神，耶和華就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」 （利26‧14－46）

en.text: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

zhSimplified.text: 「你若不听从耶和华—你 神的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上：

zhTraditional.text: 「你若不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，不謹守遵行他的一切誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，這以下的咒詛都必追隨你，臨到你身上：

en.text: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

zhSimplified.text: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 你在城裏必受咒詛，在田間也必受咒詛。

en.text: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

zhSimplified.text: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必受咒詛。

en.text: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

zhSimplified.text: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必受咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 你身所生的，地所產的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必受咒詛。

en.text: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

zhSimplified.text: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 你出也受咒詛，入也受咒詛。

en.text: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅、扰乱、责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速地灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華因你行惡離棄他，必在你手裏所辦的一切事上，使咒詛、擾亂、責罰臨到你，直到你被毀滅，速速地滅亡。

en.text: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必使瘟疫貼在你身上，直到他將你從所進去得為業的地上滅絕。

en.text: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华要用痨病、热病、火症、疟疾、刀剑、旱风、霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華要用癆病、熱病、火症、瘧疾、刀劍、旱風、霉爛攻擊你。這都要追趕你，直到你滅亡。

en.text: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

zhSimplified.text: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。

zhTraditional.text: 你頭上的天要變為銅，腳下的地要變為鐵。

en.text: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華要使那降在你地上的雨變為塵沙，從天臨在你身上，直到你滅亡。

en.text: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華必使你敗在仇敵面前，你從一條路去攻擊他們，必從七條路逃跑。你必在天下萬國中拋來拋去。

en.text: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

zhSimplified.text: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人哄赶。

zhTraditional.text: 你的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的走獸作食物，並無人鬨趕。

en.text: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮、牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必用埃及人的瘡並痔瘡、牛皮癬與疥攻擊你，使你不能醫治。

en.text: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心惊攻击你。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必用癲狂、眼瞎、心驚攻擊你。

en.text: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

zhSimplified.text: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压、抢夺，无人搭救。

zhTraditional.text: 你必在午間摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一樣。你所行的必不亨通，時常遭遇欺壓、搶奪，無人搭救。

en.text: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

zhSimplified.text: 你聘定了妻，别人必与她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其内；你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。

zhTraditional.text: 你聘定了妻，別人必與她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其內；你栽種葡萄園，也不得用其中的果子。

en.text: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

zhSimplified.text: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃它的肉；你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还；你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。

zhTraditional.text: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驢在你眼前被搶奪，不得歸還；你的羊歸了仇敵，無人搭救。

en.text: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

zhSimplified.text: 你的儿女必归与别国的民；你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。

zhTraditional.text: 你的兒女必歸與別國的民；你的眼目終日切望，甚至失明，你手中無力拯救。

en.text: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

zhSimplified.text: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，

zhTraditional.text: 你的土產和你勞碌得來的，必被你所不認識的國民吃盡。你時常被欺負，受壓制，

en.text: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。

zhTraditional.text: 甚至你因眼中所看見的，必致瘋狂。

en.text: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必攻擊你，使你膝上腿上，從腳掌到頭頂，長毒瘡無法醫治。

en.text: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去；在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華必將你和你所立的王領到你和你列祖素不認識的國去；在那裏你必事奉木頭石頭的神。

en.text: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.

zhSimplified.text: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇、笑谈、讥诮。

zhTraditional.text: 你在耶和華領你到的各國中，要令人驚駭、笑談、譏誚。

en.text: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

zhSimplified.text: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。

zhTraditional.text: 你帶到田間的種子雖多，收進來的卻少，因為被蝗蟲吃了。

en.text: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

zhSimplified.text: 你栽种、修理葡萄园，却不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为被虫子吃了。

zhTraditional.text: 你栽種、修理葡萄園，卻不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因為被蟲子吃了。

en.text: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

zhSimplified.text: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。

zhTraditional.text: 你全境有橄欖樹，卻不得其油抹身，因為樹上的橄欖不熟自落了。

en.text: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

zhSimplified.text: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。

zhTraditional.text: 你生兒養女，卻不算是你的，因為必被擄去。

en.text: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

zhSimplified.text: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。

zhTraditional.text: 你所有的樹木和你地裏的出產必被蝗蟲所吃。

en.text: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

zhSimplified.text: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。

zhTraditional.text: 在你中間寄居的，必漸漸上升，比你高而又高；你必漸漸下降，低而又低。

en.text: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

zhSimplified.text: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作首，你必作尾。

zhTraditional.text: 他必借給你，你卻不能借給他；他必作首，你必作尾。

en.text: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

zhSimplified.text: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡；因为你不听从耶和华—你 神的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。

zhTraditional.text: 這一切咒詛必追隨你，趕上你，直到你滅亡；因為你不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，不遵守他所吩咐的誡命律例。

en.text: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

zhSimplified.text: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！

zhTraditional.text: 這些咒詛必在你和你後裔的身上成為異蹟奇事，直到永遠！

en.text: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

zhSimplified.text: 「因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意地事奉耶和华—你的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 「因為你富有的時候，不歡心樂意地事奉耶和華－你的上帝，

en.text: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

zhSimplified.text: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。

zhTraditional.text: 所以你必在飢餓、乾渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和華所打發來攻擊你的仇敵。他必把鐵軛加在你的頸項上，直到將你滅絕。

en.text: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华要从远方、地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華要從遠方、地極帶一國的民，如鷹飛來攻擊你。這民的言語，你不懂得。

en.text: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

zhSimplified.text: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。

zhTraditional.text: 這民的面貌凶惡，不顧恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。

en.text: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

zhSimplified.text: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。

zhTraditional.text: 他們必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所產的，直到你滅亡。你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔，都不給你留下，直到將你滅絕。

en.text: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

zhSimplified.text: 他们必将你困在你各城里，直到你所倚靠、高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华—你 神所赐你遍地的各城里。

zhTraditional.text: 他們必將你困在你各城裏，直到你所倚靠、高大堅固的城牆都被攻塌。他們必將你困在耶和華－你上帝所賜你遍地的各城裏。

en.text: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

zhSimplified.text: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华—你 神所赐给你的儿女之肉。

zhTraditional.text: 你在仇敵圍困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和華－你上帝所賜給你的兒女之肉。

en.text: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

zhSimplified.text: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女；

zhTraditional.text: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的人必惡眼看他弟兄和他懷中的妻，並他餘剩的兒女；

en.text: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。

zhTraditional.text: 甚至在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中，他要吃兒女的肉，不肯分一點給他的親人，因為他一無所剩。

en.text: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

zhSimplified.text: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看她怀中的丈夫和她的儿女。

zhTraditional.text: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的婦人，是因嬌嫩柔弱不肯把腳踏地的，必惡眼看她懷中的丈夫和她的兒女。

en.text: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

zhSimplified.text: 她两腿中间出来的婴孩与她所要生的儿女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。

zhTraditional.text: 她兩腿中間出來的嬰孩與她所要生的兒女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中將他們暗暗地吃了。

en.text: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,

footnotes.text: 28:58 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 「这书上所写律法的一切话是叫你敬畏耶和华—你 神可荣可畏的名。你若不谨守遵行，耶和华就必将奇灾，就是至大至长的灾，至重至久的病，加在你和你后裔的身上，

zhTraditional.text: 「這書上所寫律法的一切話是叫你敬畏耶和華－你上帝可榮可畏的名。你若不謹守遵行，耶和華就必將奇災，就是至大至長的災，至重至久的病，加在你和你後裔的身上，

en.text: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

zhSimplified.text: 也必使你所惧怕、埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，

zhTraditional.text: 也必使你所懼怕、埃及人的病都臨到你，貼在你身上，

en.text: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

zhSimplified.text: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病、灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 又必將沒有寫在這律法書上的各樣疾病、災殃降在你身上，直到你滅亡。

en.text: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

zhSimplified.text: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华—你 神的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們先前雖然像天上的星那樣多，卻因不聽從耶和華－你上帝的話，所剩的人數就稀少了。

en.text: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

zhSimplified.text: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡；并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。

zhTraditional.text: 先前耶和華怎樣喜悅善待你們，使你們眾多，也要照樣喜悅毀滅你們，使你們滅亡；並且你們從所要進去得的地上必被拔除。

en.text: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识、木头石头的神。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中，從地這邊到地那邊，你必在那裏事奉你和你列祖素不認識、木頭石頭的神。

en.text: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

zhSimplified.text: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地；耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。

zhTraditional.text: 在那些國中，你必不得安逸，也不得落腳之地；耶和華卻使你在那裏心中跳動，眼目失明，精神消耗。

en.text: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

zhSimplified.text: 你的性命必悬悬无定；你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。

zhTraditional.text: 你的性命必懸懸無定；你晝夜恐懼，自料性命難保。

en.text: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

zhSimplified.text: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。

zhTraditional.text: 你因心裏所恐懼的，眼中所看見的，早晨必說，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必說，巴不得到早晨才好。

en.text: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路；在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告訴你不得再見的路；在那裏你必賣己身與仇敵作奴婢，卻無人買。」
